title: Fix every violation of one lint rule (ESLint or Biome)

params.name: rule
params.description: An ESLint rule ID or Biome rule in group/rule or lint/group/rule form.

preconditions: The selected linter is installed locally and configured with the rule enabled.
At least one violation of the rule at the baseline.

criteria.pass: The linter reports zero violations of the rule, no new disable or ignore comments or linter config changes, and the test script passes.
criteria.partial: Violations dropped but not to zero, or they reached zero by disabling or ignoring the rule, changing the linter configuration, tests fail, or new parse/internal errors hide violations.
criteria.fail: The violation count did not drop, or the linter could not run.
